claims.text: The hotel is at 60 Huangpu Road in Shanghai's Hongkou District, on the banks of the Huangpu River.

findings.quote: 60 Huangpu Road,   Hongkou District, Shanghai
On the banks of the Huangpu River, lies a serene riverside retreat

claims.text: The hotel is reachable by metro lines 10 and 12.

findings.quote: metro journey to the hotel which is accessible by metro line 10 or 12.

claims.text: Shanghai Hongqiao International Airport is approximately 40 minutes by car, and Shanghai Pudong International Airport approximately 1 hour by car.

findings.quote: Shanghai Pudong International Airport is approximately 1 hour by car from the hotel, Shanghai Hongqiao International Airport is approximately 40 minutes by car from the hotel.

claims.text: The hotel is minutes from Nanjing Road, just across the bridge from the main Bund promenade.

findings.quote: You are right on the Bund, just across the bridge from the main promenade and minutes from bustling Nanjing Road’s famous avenue of shops and restaurants.

claims.text: Historic elements of the former hotel remain, including a grand piano and a white stone spiral staircase rising to the second-floor banquet rooms.

findings.quote: Historic elements of the former hotel remain today, including a grand piano and white stone, spiral staircase that rises up to the second-floor banquet rooms.

claims.text: Each guestroom is designed to feel like a shipboard stateroom with an Oasis Bathroom, and the majority overlook the Huangpu River and Shanghai skyline.

findings.quote: each guestroom feels like an elegant shipboard stateroom with an Oasis Bathroom, the majority overlooking the Huangpu River and Shanghai skyline.
findings.note: stateroom, Oasis Bathroom, majority river views

claims.text: The Classic Garden Bridge View Room is a corner riverfront room looking onto the Garden Bridge.

findings.quote: From your corner riverfront oasis, awaken to watch Shanghai come to life on the Garden Bridge
findings.note: corner riverfront, Garden Bridge (Classic Garden Bridge View Room section)

claims.text: Conde, on the fifth floor, serves Western cuisine with views of the Shanghai skyline.

findings.quote:
Cuisine

contrast beautifully with the dazzling views of the Shanghai skyline

claims.text: Jin Lin, on the third floor, serves authentic Cantonese cuisine.

findings.quote: Authentic Cantonese
Jin Lin Chinese restaurant on the third floor opens for lunch and dinner with a Cantonese menu.

claims.text: Harmonia's breakfast buffet has live cooking stations, including an area to watch handmade dumplings being rolled.

findings.quote: Its breakfast buffet has live cooking stations, complete with an area to watch handmade dumplings rolled a la minute.

claims.text: Conde Boutique, just off the lobby, is a pastry shop with a show kitchen, a bar counter and a garden terrace.

findings.quote: Just off the lobby, Condé Boutique redefines the traditional pastry shop concept.
A stunning show kitchen reveals the creation of artisanal pastries, while the decadent display, convivial bar counter and garden terrace are a social hub
findings.note: show kitchen, bar counter, garden terrace

claims.text: The indoor swimming pool has tall windows with old Shanghai style mullions and a fountain.

findings.quote: natural light streams through tall windows with old Shanghai style mullions as the subtle spray of a fountain echoes the mist of the river

claims.text: The hotel was once The Seagull on the Bund hotel, dating back to the mid-1980s.

findings.quote: This was once The Seagull on the Bund hotel, dating back to the mid-1980s

claims.text: There are balconies in almost every room.

findings.quote: There are balconies in almost every room

claims.text: The hotel sits at the crossroads of the Suzhou River, next to the Garden Bridge.

findings.quote: at the crossroads of the Suzhou River, just next to the famous Garden Bridge

claims.text: The Penthouse on the Bund has 270-degree views of the Shanghai skyline and historic Bund, a grand reception hall, an outdoor terrace and a private sauna.

findings.quote: discover unparalleled scenic beauty with 270° framed views of the Shanghai skyline and historic Bund
the Penthouse on the Bund is home to a grand reception hall and outdoor terrace for entertaining
skyline views and private sauna

claims.text: Harmonia is the all-day restaurant, with an open kitchen and a garden courtyard and terrace overlooking the Bund.

findings.quote: Harmonia is the second-floor, all-day dining venue.
in a light-filled setting with a garden courtyard and terrace overlooking the Bund. The open kitchen is a showcase of chefs

claims.text: The indoor pool does not have views over the Bund.

findings.quote: While it would have been nice to peer out over the Bund while swimming, the building’s design doesn’t allow for that.

claims.text: The Conde Boutique and lobby lounge have no windows.

findings.quote: There’s also the Condé Boutique and lobby lounge, but there is no view (no windows at all).

claims.text: WhataHotel notes a busy tourist area with high foot traffic.
